The '''Gree Enclave''' was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] controlled by the isolationist [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Species/Legends|race]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the Enclave were [[Asation]], [[Licha In]], [[Lonatro]], [[Malanose]], [[Te Hasa/Legends|Te Hasa]], and [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] itself.

==History==
{{Quote|Gree are an ancient civilization, rarely seen anymore.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="TOR:TJP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Prisoner|the ''Telos''}}</ref>}}
[[File:Veragi_sector.jpg|thumb|left|240px|The Gree Enclave within the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]]]]
An ancient civilization, the Gree Empire was one of the earliest governments that predated the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which it did not join. Travel within the worlds of this region was enabled by a network of [[hypergate]]s&mdash;which allowed instant travel between two locations by tunneling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. At one point in its history, the Gree Enclave came into conflict with the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]].

With the rise of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] in circa [[35,000 BBY]], the Gree Empire were [[Defeat of the Gree Empire|defeated]] and pushed back to their home cluster by the Rakata. By the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], travel within the Enclave was restricted for non-Gree.

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the Gree Enclave had become a subsector of the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Consul-General]] [[Skalus]] officially ruled the enclave from Asation, but in practice the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] let the Gree rule their worlds. A sole [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class cruiser]] orbited Asation to give the impression of an Imperial presence.<ref name="TGE" />
